name: Sankar Narayan Mallick

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sankar Narayan Mallick writes poetry in Odia and English and works as a translator. Based in Bhubaneswar, he has also had a career in agricultural and rural development with NABARD. His translations include Pratibha Ray’s “Three Maestros”, published by Black Eagle Books in 2024.

Water carries both distance and desire in his poems here. “The Mariner and the Muse” moves between a solitary voyage and an imagined meeting, until a dolphin’s splash returns the sailor to the sea. In “The Moon and the Mirror”, the attempt to hold a reflection gives way to a quieter homecoming. Both poems leave room for longing that cannot be fully possessed.
